Frequently asked questions

The Most Commonly Asked Questions About Evolution Golf Carts

What types of golf carts can I finance through Guild?

We offer flexible financing options for a wide range of Evolution golf carts, including electric models and premium luxury editions.

What warranty is offered when I purchase a new Evolution Golf Cart?

Our new Evolution golf carts come with an industry-leading 8-year warranty, ensuring long-lasting performance and peace of mind.

Why is a lithium battery better?

Evolution golf carts feature advanced lithium batteries that provide a longer lifespan, faster charging, and superior performance compared to traditional lead-acid batteries.

Can I get my golf cart delivered?

Yes, we offer convenient delivery options for all our Evolution models. Contact our team to arrange delivery to your preferred location.

Need more help?
Our friendly team is available to answer any other questions or provide additional details. Feel free to reach out for personalized assistance.
